import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static char[][] grid1 = new char[15][15];
    static char[][] grid2 = new char[15][15];
    static final int[] dx = {-1, 1, 0, 0};
    static final int[] dy = {0, 0, -1, 1};
    static int[][][] timeLayerIdx = new int[65][15][15];
    static int[][] minTime = new int[15][15];
    static int nodeIdCounter = 1;

    static class Edge {
        int from, to;
        long cap, flow;

        Edge() {}

        Edge(int f, int t, long c) {
            from = f;
            to = t;
            cap = c;
            flow = 0;
        }
    }

    static class DinicAlgorithm {
        int N;
        List<Edge> edgeList;
        List<List<Integer>> adj;
        int[] depth;
        int[] current;

        DinicAlgorithm(int n) {
            N = n;
            edgeList = new ArrayList<>();
            adj = new ArrayList<>(n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
            depth = new int[n];
            current = new int[n];
        }

        void connect(int u, int v, long capacity) {
            if (u == v) return;
            edgeList.add(new Edge(u, v, capacity));
            adj.get(u).add(edgeList.size() - 1);
            edgeList.add(new Edge(v, u, 0));
            adj.get(v).add(edgeList.size() - 1);
        }

        boolean buildLevels(int src, int dst) {
            Arrays.fill(depth, N + 1);
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.offer(src);
            depth[src] = 0;
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                if (u == dst) break;
                for (int idx : adj.get(u)) {
                    Edge e = edgeList.get(idx);
                    if (e.flow < e.cap && depth[e.to] > depth[e.from] + 1) {
                        depth[e.to] = depth[e.from] + 1;
                        q.offer(e.to);
                    }
                }
            }
            return depth[dst] <= N;
        }

        long pushFlow(int u, int dst, long limit) {
            if (u == dst || limit == 0) return limit;
            for (int i = current[u]; i < adj.get(u).size(); i++) {
                current[u] = i;
                Edge e = edgeList.get(adj.get(u).get(i));
                Edge rev = edgeList.get(adj.get(u).get(i) ^ 1);
                if (depth[e.to] == depth[e.from] + 1) {
                    long available = e.cap - e.flow;
                    if (limit != -1 && available > limit) available = limit;
                    long pushed = pushFlow(e.to, dst, available);
                    if (pushed > 0) {
                        e.flow += pushed;
                        rev.flow -= pushed;
                        return pushed;
                    }
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }

        long maxFlow(int src, int dst) {
            long total = 0;
            while (buildLevels(src, dst)) {
                Arrays.fill(current, 0);
                long pushed;
                while ((pushed = pushFlow(src, dst, -1)) > 0) {
                    total += pushed;
                }
            }
            return total;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        
        for (int i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(minTime[i], -1);
        }
        
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int t = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                grid1[i][j] = line.charAt(j - 1);
            }
        }
        
        for (int layer = 0; layer <= t + 1; layer++) {
            for (int r = 1; r <= n; r++) {
                for (int c = 1; c <= n; c++) {
                    timeLayerIdx[layer][r][c] = nodeIdCounter++;
                }
            }
        }
        nodeIdCounter++;
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                grid2[i][j] = line.charAt(j - 1);
            }
        }
        
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (grid1[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    q.offer(new int[]{i, j});
                    minTime[i][j] = 0;
                }
            }
        }
        
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = q.poll();
            int y = cell[0], x = cell[1];
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int ny = y + dx[d], nx = x + dy[d];
                if (ny >= 1 && ny <= n && nx >= 1 && nx <= n && grid1[ny][nx] != 'Y' && minTime[ny][nx] == -1) {
                    minTime[ny][nx] = minTime[y][x] + 1;
                    q.offer(new int[]{ny, nx});
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (minTime[i][j] == -1) minTime[i][j] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
                if (minTime[i][j] > t) minTime[i][j] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            }
        }
        
        int source = 0;
        int sink = nodeIdCounter - 1;
        DinicAlgorithm solver = new DinicAlgorithm(nodeIdCounter);
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (grid1[i][j] >= '1' && grid1[i][j] <= '9') {
                    solver.connect(source, timeLayerIdx[0][i][j], grid1[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (grid1[i][j] == 'Y' || grid1[i][j] == 'Z') continue;
                for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                    int ny = i + dx[d], nj = j + dy[d];
                    if (ny >= 1 && ny <= n && nj >= 1 && nj <= n && grid1[ny][nj] != 'Y' && grid1[ny][nj] != 'Z') {
                        for (int step = 0; step < t; step++) {
                            if (minTime[ny][nj] >= step + 1 && minTime[i][j] > step) {
                                solver.connect(timeLayerIdx[step][i][j], timeLayerIdx[step + 1][ny][nj], 1000);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (grid1[i][j] == 'Y' || grid1[i][j] == 'Z') continue;
                for (int step = 0; step <= t; step++) {
                    if (grid2[i][j] >= '1' && grid2[i][j] <= '9') {
                        solver.connect(timeLayerIdx[step][i][j], timeLayerIdx[t + 1][i][j], grid2[i][j] - '0');
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (grid1[i][j] == 'Y' || grid1[i][j] == 'Z') continue;
                if (grid2[i][j] >= '1' && grid2[i][j] <= '9') {
                    solver.connect(timeLayerIdx[t + 1][i][j], sink, grid2[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        
        System.out.println((int) solver.maxFlow(source, sink));
        sc.close();
    }
}
